images.descEn: Original series: a broad flat hexagonal platform of brushed steel hovering a short distance above the ground, its underside ringed with three evenly spaced emitter nozzles glowing a steady teal, a soft cushion of teal light spreading down from the nozzles onto the ground, the platform surface covered with a shallow raised grid pattern and a single circular recessed port at its centre, steel edges worn and slightly dented, dust particles drifting in the light cushion, device catalogue style

images.name: 便携力场发生器 · 奇械科技
images.desc: 原创系列：矮壮便携发生器取深板岩复合材料立于四短脚，顶部穹顶发射器向上一拢，罩住上半身的半球形淡绿透明力场，场表荡着细密同心涟漪，器身三处散热口泛浅绿光，顶上一道厚重提手，外壳磕凹带使用包浆，场沿接地处积一小滩绿光，器械图鉴风
images.descEn: Original series: a stubby portable generator of dark slate composite material on four short feet, a domed emitter on top projecting a broad translucent hemispherical force field of pale lime green light surrounding the upper part of the device, the field rippling with faint concentric distortion rings, three cooling vents glowing faint lime on the sides, a heavy carry handle arched over the top, the body dented and scratched with a patina of use, a small pool of green light where the field meets the ground, device catalogue style

images.name: 折光伏击者 · 异星猎食
images.desc: 原创系列：无眼无面的伏击型掠食者。躯干是一叠竖向折起的半透明硅质晶板，边缘泛油膜般虹彩而中心近乎透明，像一枚收拢待发的弹簧陷阱；三条反关节长腿撑起身体，趾爪张开，基部由数根苍白须根锚进地面；肩部伸出一根细柄，末端垂着一枚多棱面琥珀诱饵果，正滴落一滴黏液。体表干燥、纸质、矿物感，绝不湿滑。骨白、灰烬、虹彩与病态琥珀四色。异星生物图鉴风
images.descEn: Original series: an eyeless faceless ambush predator. Its torso is a vertical accordion-fold of translucent crystalline silica plates, edges shimmering with oil-slick iridescence while the centre stays almost invisible, held compact like a cocked spring trap. Three long reverse-jointed legs brace the body, toes splayed, anchored to the ground by pale tendril roots. A slender stalk rises from the shoulder, ending in a faceted amber lure-fruit dripping a single sticky drop. Texture is dry, papery and mineral, never slimy. Bone white, ash grey, iridescent film and sickly amber. Alien creature catalogue style

images.name: 鸣骨吸附者 · 异星猎食
images.desc: 原创系列：扁平如鳐的寄生型掠食者。身体由一具敞开的螺旋状湿骨肋笼构成——十二根肋骨自中央铰点向外旋出而非对称弯曲，每根肋骨末端环生一圈细小吸盘，肋骨能像手指那样屈伸抓握；无口、无眼、无面。螺旋中心悬着一片共振膜，淤紫半透明，可见同心波纹在膜上荡开；腹面是布满毛细孔的多孔海绵层。质感是湿骨、软骨与潮膜。蜡黄象牙、淤紫膜、锈褐污渍三色。异星生物图鉴风
images.descEn: Original series: a parasitic predator flattened like a stingray. Its body is an open spiral cage of wet yellowed bone: twelve ribs spiralling outward from a central hinge instead of curving symmetrically, each rib tipped with a ring of tiny suction pores, the ribs articulating like fingers to grip and walk. No mouth, no eyes, no face. A resonant membrane hangs at the centre of the spiral, bruised violet and translucent, with concentric ripples visibly spreading across it; the underside is a porous sponge of capillary pores. Texture of wet bone, gristle and damp membrane. Jaundiced ivory, bruised violet and rust-brown stains. Alien creature catalogue style

images.name: 孢丝织者 · 异星猎食
images.desc: 原创系列：低伏蹲踞的真菌型掠食者，三足反关节，没有头。本该是脸的位置，一枚孢囊裂成五片湿毡质瓣，瓣缝间藏着一簇细小的珠状眼。肩部不生手臂而是两束苍白菌丝，正甩出孢丝，其中一束末端缠着一只拳头大小的猎物茧，丝线正往茧缝里钻。背部覆满会搏动的细纤毛与潮湿菌毡，撒着淡紫孢子粉。质感是湿毡、菌丝与湿土。白垩、湿板岩灰、淡紫孢子粉与一颗湿琥珀珠。异星生物图鉴风
images.descEn: Original series: a hunched low-slung fungal predator, tripedal and reverse-jointed, with no head. Where a face would be, a spore sac splits open into five flaps of wet felt, a cluster of small bead-like eyes hidden in the seams between them. Instead of arms, two bundles of pale hyphae extend from the shoulders, mid-casting; one thread ends in a fist-sized prey cocoon, the filaments visibly sinking into its seams. Its back is covered in pulsing fine cilia and damp mycelial felt, dusted with lilac spore powder. Texture of wet felt, mycelium and damp soil. Chalk white, wet slate grey, lilac dust and one wet amber bead. Alien creature catalogue style

images.name: 脉孢囊壶 · 异星猎食
images.desc: 原创系列：异星食人植物。一根粗壮的肉质柄自一团根瘤隆起，顶端是一枚半透明囊壶，壶身一道竖直的括约肌式裂缝半开着；壶内可见猎物的半溶解残影悬在琥珀色消化液中，壶壁上爬着搏动的脉管；三根僵硬的倒刺须像护肋那样拱在壶顶，光合质地的墨绿蜡光。整株像在呼吸，壶壁微微鼓胀。无花、无瓣、无叶。墨绿、半透明琥珀与蜡黄脉管三色。异星植被图鉴风
images.descEn: Original series: an alien carnivorous plant. A thick fleshy stalk rises from a burl of root-nodes and ends in a translucent bladder-pod with a vertical sphincter slit, half-open. Inside the pod, half-dissolved prey remains hang as dark silhouettes suspended in amber digestive fluid, and pulsing veins crawl across the pod wall. Three stiff barbed tendrils arch over the pod like protective ribs, photosynthetic and green-black with a waxy sheen. The whole plant appears to breathe, the pod walls slightly distended. No flowers, no petals, no leaves. Green-black, translucent amber and jaundiced yellow veins. Alien flora catalogue style

images.name: 血蕊诱桩 · 异星猎食
images.desc: 原创系列：异星食人植物。一根硬直的柄，外表像昆虫胸板那样分节，自浅根瘤升起，顶端是一枚多棱面琥珀腺果，正往下淌着浓稠的诱引液，沿柄凝成一道道硬化的流痕；基座周围六根僵硬的光合须向内勾着倒刺，每根须尖有一个小孔，正呼出淡淡可见的蒸汽。无花、无瓣、无叶，柄身微妙地像一根饲管。骨白、钙化米白、琥珀腺果与墨绿倒刺。异星植被图鉴风
images.descEn: Original series: an alien carnivorous lure-plant. A tall rigid stalk, ribbed like an insect sternum, rises from a shallow burl of root-nodes and ends in a faceted amber gland-fruit that weeps thick glistening attractant down the stalk in hardened rivulets. Around the base, six stiff photosynthetic tendrils bristle with inward-curving barbs, each tipped with a tiny pore exhaling a faint visible vapor. No flowers, no petals, no leaves; the stalk subtly resembles a feeding tube. Bone, calcified off-white, amber gland and black-green barbs. Alien flora catalogue style

images.name: 折光出击 · 异星猎食
images.desc: 原创系列：捕食瞬间。折光伏击者自收拢姿态向上弹开，半透明晶板叠成的躯干伸到静止时的两倍长，板片张开把光折射成一圈圈油膜光带；三条反关节腿死死撑住，趾爪张开抓地；肩柄上的琥珀诱饵果甩到前方，柄腱绷直，正滴落黏液；一圈折射激波环在伸长的躯干外围扩散。无眼、无面、无口。干燥纸质的矿物质感。骨白、灰烬、虹彩与琥珀。异星生物图鉴风
images.descEn: Original series: the moment of the strike. The prism stalker has unfolded upward from its cocked posture, its accordion torso of translucent crystalline plates extended to twice its resting length, the plates splayed and refracting light into bands of oil-slick colour. Its three reverse-jointed legs brace hard, toes splayed and gripping. The amber lure-fruit on its shoulder stalk swings forward, snapped taut on a strained tendon, dripping. A shock-ring of refracted light spreads around the extended torso. No eyes, no face, no mouth. Dry papery mineral texture. Bone white, ash grey, iridescent film and amber. Alien creature catalogue style

images.name: 徽章 · 低音核
images.desc: 霓虹线稿小徽章，喇叭形低音盆造型
images.descEn: Neon line-art badge shaped like a horn speaker cone

images.name: 徽章 · 晶铃
images.desc: 霓虹线稿小徽章，悬挂式水晶铃铛造型
images.descEn: Neon line-art badge shaped like a hanging crystal bell

images.name: 徽章 · 等离子
images.desc: 霓虹线稿小徽章，等离子球与环形电弧造型
images.descEn: Neon line-art badge shaped like a plasma orb with an electric arc ring

images.name: 碎环星 · 星球徽志
images.desc: 奇怪星球图标：球体被一圈不连续的碎岩星环环绕，环上有缺口而非平滑
images.descEn: A weird planet icon: a sphere encircled by a discontinuous ring of broken floating rock shards with visible gaps, not a smooth ring

images.name: 孕星 · 星球徽志
images.desc: 奇怪星球图标：半透明蛋壳状外壳星球内，浮着一颗更小的发光行星
images.descEn: A weird planet icon: a translucent eggshell-like shell planet with a smaller glowing planet floating inside it

images.name: 凝视星 · 星球徽志
images.desc: 奇怪星球图标：整个表面是一只巨眼，瞳孔是漩涡星系，诡异而令人不安
images.descEn: A weird planet icon: a sphere whose whole face is one enormous eye, the iris a tiny spiral galaxy, uncanny and unsettling

images.name: 熔核星 · 星球徽志
images.desc: 奇怪星球图标：地表龟裂，裂缝透出炽热熔核，仿佛即将炸开
images.descEn: A weird planet icon: a rocky sphere with deep fissures glowing molten from within, looking about to burst

images.name: 晶立方星 · 星球徽志
images.desc: 奇怪星球图标：不是球，而是一颗带圆角的立方体行星，低多边形玩具质感
images.descEn: A weird planet icon: not a sphere but a rounded cube planet with beveled edges, low-poly toy look

images.name: 脐行星 · 星球徽志
images.desc: 奇怪星球图标：两颗大小不一的星球部分融合，被一条发光脐带状光带相连
images.descEn: A weird planet icon: two spheres of different sizes partly merged, joined by a glowing umbilical band of light

images.name: 小人挖矿 · 动图
images.desc: 无缝循环小动画：小人抢起镐头砸向矿石，撞击瞬间火花四溅、碎石飞散，透明底 WebP，2 秒一轮
images.descEn: A seamless loop: a little figure swinging a pickaxe into rock, sparks and rubble bursting on impact, transparent WebP, 2s per cycle

images.name: 小人钓鱼 · 动图
images.desc: 无缝循环小动画：小人水岸垂钓，浮漂轻点、鱼线绷紧，一尾小鱼抢食跳出水面，透明底 WebP，3 秒一轮
images.descEn: A seamless loop: a little figure fishing by the water, bobber dipping, line tightening, a small fish leaping for the bait, transparent WebP, 3s per cycle

images.name: 小人射击 · 动图
images.desc: 无缝循环小动画：小人抬手开枪，枪口焰一亮、弹道拖着弹痕命中木靶，弹壳抛飞、硝烟未散，透明底 WebP，2.5 秒一轮
images.descEn: A seamless loop: a little figure firing a pistol, muzzle flash, a tracer hitting the wooden target, shell ejecting, smoke lingering, transparent WebP, 2.5s per cycle

images.name: 螺壳号 · 古怪乐器
images.desc: 古怪乐器：整只巨型螺壳就是号身，壳口焊了一截远古青铜吹嘴，壳沿还铆着风干的木板条与皮绳
images.descEn: A weird instrument: a giant snail shell is the body, with an ancient bronze mouthpiece welded to the opening, dried wood slats and leather straps riveted along the rim

images.name: 鱼骨琴 · 古怪乐器
images.desc: 古怪乐器：用一头深海巨鱼的肋骨搭成琴框、头骨做共鸣箱，牛筋做弦，下面还坠了几枚贝壳和浮木珠子
images.descEn: A weird instrument: a harp framed with the rib bones of a deep-sea fish, its skull as the resonator, sinew strings, seashells and driftwood beads hanging below

images.name: 触手风琴 · 古怪乐器
images.desc: 古怪乐器：管风琴的八根音管是八条活过来的章鱼触手，铜吸盘沿管身排布，风箱一鼓，管口就泛出幽幽的青光
images.descEn: A weird instrument: a pipe organ whose eight pipes are eight living octopus tentacles with brass suckers, faint teal glow seeping from the pipe openings when the bellows swell

images.name: 晶皮鼓 · 古怪乐器
images.desc: 古怪乐器：鼓面是一整张半透明的琥珀晶膜，敲一下就有暖光在皮下脉动一圈，鼓沿刻满同心符文，皮绳穿过骨钉勒紧晶膜
images.descEn: A weird instrument: a frame drum with a translucent amber crystal skin, a warm pulse of light rippling under the membrane with every beat, concentric runes carved on the rim, leather cords drawn tight through bone pegs

images.name: 扭力弩炮 · 物理武器
images.desc: 物理武器：不靠魔法靠绳劲，两束绞紧的麻绳当扭力簧，橡木架包铁，轨道上一支铁簇弩箭已经上膛，旁边还留着绞盘手柄
images.descEn: A physics weapon: no magic, just rope force, two twisted rope skeins as torsion springs, iron-banded oak frame, an iron-tipped bolt loaded on the track, winch handle still in place

images.name: 弹簧拳套 · 物理武器
images.desc: 物理武器：一副纯机械的增压拳套，指节是黄铜墩，手背架着两根粗钢弹簧和活塞杆，出拳全靠弹簧回弹加速
images.descEn: A physics weapon: a purely mechanical power glove, brass-knuckle fist, two thick steel springs and piston rods mounted on the back of the hand, punch speed comes from spring rebound alone

images.name: 钉头链锤 · 物理武器
images.desc: 物理武器：中世纪老链锤，碗口大的铁球钉满方锥，几节沉甸甸的铁链接在铁箍木柄上，缠着防滑的皮握条
images.descEn: A physics weapon: a medieval flail, an iron ball the size of a bowl studded with square pyramid spikes, heavy chain links to an iron-collared wooden haft wrapped with a leather grip

images.name: 弹弓杖 · 物理武器
images.desc: 物理武器：一根加长的 Y 形弹弓杖，皮兜绷紧兜着一颗浑圆的河石，叉尖包铁，杖身缠满麻绳握把，甩出去全是离心力
images.descEn: A physics weapon: an elongated Y-shaped staff sling, taut leather pouch cradling a round river stone, iron-capped fork tips, twine-wrapped grip, pure centrifugal force on the release

images.name: 南瓜四臂 · 变异稻草人
images.desc: 变异稻草人：南瓜头刻着夸张的咧嘴笑，四条塞满稻草的麻袋手臂从补丁外套里伸出来，安全别针别着衣襟，稻草从缝里爆出来
images.descEn: A mutant scarecrow: a carved grinning pumpkin head, four straw-stuffed burlap arms sprouting from a safety-pinned patchwork coat, straw bursting from every seam

images.name: 麻袋头 · 变异稻草人
images.desc: 变异稻草人：脑袋是一只粗麻袋，缝着一张大嘴和四颗歪歪扭扭的纽扣眼，四肢一长一短，法兰兰衬衫和破裤子上到处往外钻稻草
images.descEn: A mutant scarecrow: a coarse burlap sack for a head, a crude stitched mouth and four crooked button eyes, mismatched lanky limbs, straw poking out of a ragged flannel shirt and torn trousers

images.name: 鸦骨 · 变异稻草人
images.desc: 变异稻草人：一颗光秃秃的乌鸦头骨当了脑袋，黑羽毛从塞满稻草的衬衫里穿透出来，双手是尖利的鸟爪，还披了一条破烂黑斗篷
images.descEn: A mutant scarecrow: a bare crow skull for a head, glossy black feathers piercing through the straw-stuffed shirt, sharp talon hands, draped in a tattered black cloak

images.name: 向日葵藤 · 变异稻草人
images.desc: 变异稻草人：脑袋是一朵开歪了的向日葵，蔫花瓣往下垂，两条胳膊换成扭动的绿藤蔓，指头是荆棘刺，胸口裂开往外涌稻草
images.descEn: A mutant scarecrow: a lopsided blooming sunflower for a head with wilting petals, twisting green vines for arms with thorny twig fingers, straw gushing from a split chest

images.name: 环牙巨口 · 多牙生物
images.desc: 多牙生物：鲨形怪长了一张巨型圆口，一圈圈同心针牙从喉咙一直排到唇边，破烂的鳍、疤疤赖赖的灰蓝皮，张嘴朝着你
images.descEn: A many-fanged beast: a shark-like monster with a gigantic circular maw, dozens of concentric rings of needle teeth from throat to lips, ragged torn fins and scarred gray-blue hide, jaws wide open

images.name: 角牙鳗 · 多牙生物
images.desc: 多牙生物：鳗形怪的圆吸盘嘴上镶满几百颗细角牙，橄榄褐色的黏滑皮上开了七个鳃孔，带蹼的尾巴盘在身前，嘴正对着你
images.descEn: A many-fanged beast: an eel-like monster with a round sucker mouth ringed with hundreds of tiny horn teeth, slimy mottled olive-brown hide with seven gill holes, finned tail coiled forward, mouth facing you

images.name: 叠牙鳄 · 多牙生物
images.desc: 多牙生物：鳄形怪的上下颌挤满一圈圈参差不齐的叠牙，长短歪斜全不守规矩，疤痢痢的鳞甲皮、短粗腿、一道棱脊长尾，嘴朝着你
images.descEn: A many-fanged beast: a crocodile-like monster with overlapping rows of mismatched jagged teeth jutting crookedly from its gaping jaws, scabbed armored hide, short powerful legs and a thick ridged tail, jaws facing you

images.name: 盘牙蛛 · 多牙生物
images.desc: 多牙生物：蛛形怪八只眼簇成一排，底下盘着一圈弯牙，螯牙滴着黏液，毛腿关节分明，鼓囊囊的肚子上立着一撮撮刚毛，前身高抬
images.descEn: A many-fanged beast: a spider-like monster with eight clustered eyes and a coiled jaw of curved fangs above dripping mandibles, hairy jointed legs, a bulbous abdomen bristling with tufts, front raised

images.name: 熔裂石 · 古怪外星石头
images.desc: 古怪外星石头：一块自己悬在空中的焦炭壳巨石，被一道熔岩裂缝劈开，几片尖碎的石片已经漂离母体，缝里透出灼热的橙光
images.descEn: A weird alien stone: a charcoal-crusted boulder hovering in empty space, split by a molten crack, jagged shards already drifting from the main mass, glowing orange light seeping from the fissure

images.name: 环纹石 · 古怪外星石头
images.desc: 古怪外星石头：一块被风磨光的石头，从极到极刻满一圈圈同心环纹，沟槽里泛着幽幽的青磷光，脊线上还冒出几颗畸形的晶疙瘩
images.descEn: A weird alien stone: a weather-polished stone covered in concentric carved rings from pole to pole, faint teal glow in the grooves, odd crystalline bumps along the ridges

images.name: 晶簇石 · 古怪外星石头
images.desc: 古怪外星石头：一块其貌不扬的灰壳晶洞石，裂口处却透出半透明的琥珀光泽，里面插着一簇尖利的紫色晶柱
images.descEn: A weird alien stone: a dull-looking geode stone, translucent amber glow seeping from a broken opening, a sharp cluster of violet crystals glittering inside

images.name: 蜂窝浮石 · 古怪外星石头
images.desc: 古怪外星石头：一块外星浮石，密密麻麻的深孔全是从前熔岩里逃出来的气泡留下的，孔沿磨得玻璃一样滑，缝里渗出淡青色的矿脉
images.descEn: A weird alien stone: an alien pumice riddled with deep honeycomb holes left by escaping lava bubbles, glassy smooth rims, faint teal mineral veins in the crevices

images.name: 阿岩 · 仿古旅人
images.desc: 比老张更细腻的原创小人：阿岩，一位风尘仆仆的仿古旅人，身着做旧皮外套、黄铜护目镜，手持地图
images.descEn: A more detailed original little figure than Laozhang: A-Yan, a weathered vintage traveler in a worn leather coat with brass goggles, holding a map

images.name: 玄夜 · 星轨工程师

images.name: 滑板青年 · 都市小民
images.desc: 都市小民：现代街头滑板青年，宽松淡紫卫衣配卡其工装裤，脚踩红白旧板鞋，一手拎着竖起的滑板，另一手插兜
images.descEn: Modern folk: a street skater in an oversized lilac hoodie and khaki cargo pants, one foot on a worn red-and-white skateboard, other hand in pocket

images.name: 夜班司机 · 都市小民
images.desc: 都市小民：现代夜班网约车司机，墨绿飞行夹克罩灰色连帽卫衣，一手拿不锈钢保温杯一手拎充电线，有点困但友善
images.descEn: Modern folk: a night-shift ride-hailing driver in a dark teal bomber jacket over a grey hoodie, holding a steel thermos and a phone charger cable

images.name: 护目镜怪老头 · 古怪老人
images.desc: 古怪老人：白发炸毛、眉毛浓密的老头，额头架着黄铜护目镜，穿破旧蓝绿长风衣，腋下夹一把古董黄铜望远镜，咧嘴坏笑
images.descEn: Eccentric elder: a wild-haired old man with brass goggles on his forehead, a tattered teal coat and an antique telescope under one arm, grinning mischievously

images.name: 提笼怪老翁 · 古怪老人
images.desc: 古怪老人：戴小瓜皮帽、穿酱紫棉袄的驼背老翁，手提圆竹鸟笼，笼里蹲着一只粉色怪眼小生物，眯眼狡黠，长山羊胡
images.descEn: Eccentric elder: a stooped old codger in a melon cap and plum padded jacket carrying a round bamboo cage with a tiny pink oddity inside

images.name: 游方苔衣婆婆 · 古怪老人
images.desc: 古怪老人：裹着干苔色补丁斗篷的游方老婆婆，拄一根顶端发芽发光的扭曲藤杖，鹰钩鼻、一只眼浑浊，指上铜环数枚
images.descEn: Eccentric elder: a wandering old woman wrapped in a moss-colored patchwork cloak, leaning on a gnarled staff sprouting a glowing bud

images.name: 抱陶罐胖婶 · 古怪老人
images.desc: 古怪老人：戴波点花头巾、穿赭黄围裙的胖老婶，怀里抱着一只绘青花的大陶罐，脸颊红润缺两颗牙，笑得灿烂，踩毡拖鞋
images.descEn: Eccentric elder: a plump granny in a polka-dot headscarf and ochre apron hugging a blue-painted ceramic crock, laughing with a gap-toothed grin

images.name: 羽毛帽老园丁 · 古怪老人
images.desc: 古怪老人：戴夸张羽毛宽檐帽的老园丁，穿绿叶马甲与沾泥裤子，怀里的盆栽叶片上长着小脸，鼻尖沾土，一手捏小铲子，得意洋洋
images.descEn: Eccentric elder: an old gardener under an absurd feathered hat in a leafy waistcoat, cradling a potted plant with a tiny face on its leaf, proud as punch

images.name: 油灯怪老太 · 古怪老人
images.desc: 古怪老人：穿蓝背带裤、披针织披肩的老太，圆眼镜滑到鼻尖，一手举起发暖光的黄铜油灯，从镜片上方狐疑地打量人，灰白发髻
images.descEn: Eccentric elder: an old crone in blue overalls and a knitted shawl, spectacles slipping down her nose, holding up a warm brass oil lantern and peering over them

images.name: 火苗小鬼 · 古怪小鬼
images.desc: 古怪小鬼：李子紫圆滚滚小鬼，两只短犄角，尾巴卷成圈收个铲形尖，琥珀大眼竖瞳，一手捏着小火苗，爪脚悬空
images.descEn: Wee imp: a plum-colored pear-bodied imp with stubby horns, a coiled spade tail and huge amber eyes, holding a tiny flame

images.name: 钥匙幽灵鬼 · 古怪小鬼
images.desc: 古怪小鬼：淡青半透明幽灵小鬼，钟形塌身，一大一小两只眼，咧嘴露獠牙，拖着细细雾尾，抱一把比自己还大的黄铜钥匙
images.descEn: Wee imp: a lumpy pale-teal ghost imp with mismatched eyes and a snaggletooth grin, hugging an oversized brass key

images.name: 蘑菇伞毛鬼 · 古怪小鬼
images.desc: 古怪小鬼：苔绿短毛圆身小鬼，蝙蝠大耳长尖鼻，举一朵小蘑菇当伞，眼珠斜瞟一脸坏相，两只小蹄脚悬着
images.descEn: Wee imp: a moss-green furry imp with big bat ears and a pointed nose, holding a tiny toadstool umbrella with a sideways glance

images.name: 偷茶杯独角鬼 · 古怪小鬼
images.desc: 古怪小鬼：砖红皮大肚捣蛋鬼，额头一支螺旋独角，满口歪牙大嘴，双手死死抱住偷来的茶杯，一只尖耳打折，罗圈小腿站着
images.descEn: Wee imp: a pot-bellied brick-red trickster with a single spiral horn and a mouth of crooked teeth, clutching a stolen teacup

images.name: 烟灰钱袋鬼 · 古怪小鬼
images.desc: 古怪小鬼：烟灰色土块身小鬼，两只烛火黄的圆眼，咧嘴缺一颗牙，细长胳膊搂着一小袋露头的铜钱，脚下拖一缕烟
images.descEn: Wee imp: a soot-grey lumpen imp with candle-yellow eyes and a gap-toothed grin, hugging a burlap sack of coins with wispy smoke trailing

images.name: 月牙小仙鬼 · 古怪小鬼
images.desc: 古怪小鬼：薰衣草紫圆身小鬼，头顶光环加蜡烛泪滴做的小皇冠，两眼一高一低，盘腿悬浮，怀里搂着一只月牙形金坠子
images.descEn: Wee imp: a chubby lavender imp with a ringed halo and wax-drip crown, floating cross-legged while cradling a crescent golden bauble

images.name: 鬃毛翼狮兽 · 会飞的猛兽
images.desc: 会飞的猛兽：石板蓝狮身猛兽，破边蝙蝠巨翼全张，深色羽鬃围着咆哮尖牙的嘴，长尾尾尖带穗，利爪前探
images.descEn: Flying beast: a slate-blue lion-bodied beast with huge tattered bat wings, a dark feather mane around its snarling face and claws extended

images.name: 六腿飞熊兽 · 会飞的猛兽
images.desc: 会飞的猛兽：铁锈棕六短腿圆身飞熊，一对鹰式羽翅扑腾，睡眼惺忪龇小獠牙，臀部带螺旋花纹，斜着往上飞
images.descEn: Flying beast: a rust-brown round bear beast with six stubby legs and flapping eagle wings, sleepy face with tiny tusks, soaring diagonally

images.name: 蛾翼蛇龙兽 · 会飞的猛兽
images.desc: 会飞的猛兽：深绿鳞片蛇龙兽，S 形长身蜿蜒，背上一排破边蛾翼，鲶鱼脸带须、满口尖牙，小爪鳍在空中游动
images.descEn: Flying beast: a deep-green scaled serpent coiling in an S shape with a row of tattered moth wings and a whiskered fanged catfish face

images.name: 铜翼飞猪兽 · 会飞的猛兽
images.desc: 会飞的猛兽：鬃毛浓密的野猪身飞兽，皮制暗红龙翼大张，獠牙外呲喷着气，四蹄收拢侧身飞行，脖子上挂一只开裂小铃铛
images.descEn: Flying beast: a bristly flying boar with wide leathery reddish wings, jutting tusks and a cracked little bell on its neck, banking mid-flight

images.name: 三角狼翼兽 · 会飞的猛兽
images.desc: 会飞的猛兽：暴风雨灰瘦削狼身翼兽，膜翼下压腾空跃起，绿眼发光、满口獠牙，头顶三只弯角，一只耳朵破边，长尾拖后
images.descEn: Flying beast: a lean storm-grey wolf beast mid-leap with membranous bat wings, glowing green eyes and three curved horns

images.name: 蘑菇冠飞蟾 · 会飞的猛兽
images.desc: 会飞的猛兽：橄榄绿疣皮胖飞蟾，宽嘴钝牙咧着笑，金色鼓眼，两扇彩玻璃纹虫翼，头戴一圈小蘑菇冠，四平八稳地悬浮
images.descEn: Flying beast: a fat olive warty sky toad grinning with blunt fangs and bulging golden eyes, stained-glass insect wings and a crown of little mushrooms

images.name: 笑脸蛛腿花 · 古怪花草
images.desc: 古怪花草：橙红花瓣中央开一张咧嘴笑脸，两条虫腿式条纹卷茎撑着，三片心形叶脉泛淡黄光，茎下垂着一只根脚
images.descEn: Odd plant: an orange-red flower with a grinning face at its heart, insect-leg striped stalks and heart-shaped leaves with glowing veins

images.name: 粉螺喇叭藤 · 古怪花草
images.desc: 古怪花草：粉红色螺旋开瓶器式茎干一路拧上去，顶端开一朵长满细牙的喇叭花，茎上挂着几只气球状种荚，一片叶子长成小手掌
images.descEn: Odd plant: a dusty-pink corkscrew stem twisting up to a trumpet bloom full of tiny teeth, with balloon seed pods and a hand-shaped leaf

images.name: 瞌睡靛蓝菌 · 古怪花草
images.desc: 古怪花草：三株高矮不一的靛蓝斑点蘑菇，伞盖像犯困的眼皮一样下垂，底下淡绿菌褶发光，最高那株茎基围一圈小瘤触须
images.descEn: Odd plant: three indigo spotted mushrooms of different heights with drooping sleepy caps and pale-green glowing gills

images.name: 灯笼浆果丛 · 古怪花草
images.desc: 古怪花草：矮壮深褐茎上挂着五颗玻璃感圆浆果，像小灯笼一样从里透光，褪色青绿纸扇形叶子，两条细卷须横着探出去，茎上带小刺
images.descEn: Odd plant: a squat dark stem bearing five glassy berries glowing like lanterns, fan-shaped teal leaves and two curling tendrils

images.name: 捕兽颚草 · 古怪花草
images.desc: 古怪花草：木质捕兽颚式的球茎头，两排软钝牙，条纹绿颈向前饿扑，三只粗短根须腿正在迈步，脑门带雀斑
images.descEn: Odd plant: a wooden trap-jaw bulb head with two rows of soft blunt teeth, a hungry striped neck bending forward on three stubby root-legs

images.name: 星絮蒲公英 · 古怪花草
images.desc: 古怪花草：淡紫绒球花头胀得快要炸开，飞絮全是小星星形状，疙瘩木茎上抽着两支螺旋新芽，一条根卷成问号垂着
images.descEn: Odd plant: a pale-lavender puff head about to scatter its star-shaped seeds, a gnarled knotwood stem and a root curled like a question mark

images.name: 太阳脸金项坠 · 古怪金银珠宝
images.desc: 古怪金银珠宝：扭股金链坠着太阳形大金牌，中心是一张眨眼笑脸，一圈七颗颜色各异的宝石，下面还挂着个小铃铛
images.descEn: Curious jewel: a heavy twisted gold chain holding a sun-shaped medallion with a winking face, seven mismatched gems and a little bell charm

images.name: 眼球月光石戒 · 古怪金银珠宝
images.desc: 古怪金银珠宝：宽版银戒编成辫状，戒面分出两只小爪手捧着一颗眼球形月光石，乳白石面带淡蓝光，戒圈刻满小螺旋纹
images.descEn: Curious jewel: a braided silver ring splitting into two tiny claw hands cradling an eyeball-shaped moonstone with a pale blue glint

images.name: 朝鲜蓟金冠 · 古怪金银珠宝
images.desc: 古怪金银珠宝：朝鲜蓟般层层金瓣的小金冠，九只歪歪扭扭的尖顶各镶一颗不同的怪宝石，正中垂一滴淡绿水滴石，缝隙带旧铜绿
images.descEn: Curious jewel: a squat gold crown of layered artichoke petals with nine crooked points each holding a different odd gem and a pale-green tear stone

images.name: 翡翠甲虫胸针 · 古怪金银珠宝
images.desc: 古怪金银珠宝：黄铜甲虫胸针，拱背镶满翡翠马赛克小片，两只红宝小眼，六条弹簧般卷起的金腿，两根细触须
images.descEn: Curious jewel: a brass beetle brooch with an emerald-mosaic domed shell, tiny ruby eyes and six delicate gold legs curled like springs

images.name: 螺旋眼金元宝 · 古怪金银珠宝
images.desc: 古怪金银珠宝：船形手工浇铸金锭，表面坑坑洼洼，顶上盖一枚螺旋眼印记，侧边钻了三个穿绳孔，带旧年月的划痕和凹坑
images.descEn: Curious jewel: a boat-shaped hand-poured gold ingot with a lumpy surface, a spiral eye stamp on top and three string holes along one edge

images.name: 翠鸟银簪 · 古怪金银珠宝
images.desc: 古怪金银珠宝：长银簪簪首雕着翠蓝鸟头，含一颗小珍珠眼，颈下垂着细金链加三颗玉珠的流苏，簪身刻满羽毛细纹
images.descEn: Curious jewel: a long silver hairpin ending in a carved kingfisher-blue bird head with a pearl eye and a tassel of gold chains and jade beads

images.name: 羽衣仙童 · 仙童
images.desc: 仙童：胖乎乎的小仙童披一袭羽毛羽衣，头顶小金光环，双手捧发光珍珠，飘然悬空，重墨卡通描边
images.descEn: Fairy kid: a chubby child in a feathered robe with a tiny golden halo, holding a glowing pearl, floating, heavy ink cartoon outline

images.name: 云纹仙童 · 仙童
images.desc: 仙童：头顶玉簪的小仙童骑一朵蓬松祥云，天蓝云纹袍，手持如意，微笑悬空，重墨卡通描边
images.descEn: Fairy kid: a child with a jade hairpin riding a puffy cloud, in a sky-blue cloud-embroidered robe holding a ruyi scepter, heavy ink cartoon outline

images.name: 莲台仙童 · 仙童
images.desc: 仙童：胖娃娃盘坐粉色莲台，绿叶腰带，手捧未开莲苞，头顶柔光环，重墨卡通描边
images.descEn: Fairy kid: a plump child seated on a pink lotus pedestal with a leaf sash holding a lotus bud, soft halo, heavy ink cartoon outline

images.name: 提灯仙童 · 仙童
images.desc: 仙童：头顶光环、背生光翼的小仙童，红金袍手持透暖光纸灯笼，仰望出神，重墨卡通描边
images.descEn: Fairy kid: a child with a glowing halo and light wings, in a red-gold robe holding a warm-glowing paper lantern, heavy ink cartoon outline

images.name: 飘带仙童 · 仙童
images.desc: 仙童：绿袍小仙童凌空起舞，双手甩出两道长丝带萦绕周身，双髻簪花，闭眼陶醉，重墨卡通描边
images.descEn: Fairy kid: a child in a green robe leaping in dance, two long silk ribbons swirling around, flower buns, heavy ink cartoon outline

images.name: 星冠仙童 · 仙童
images.desc: 仙童：头戴小星冠、生羽毛小翼的仙童，手持星尖魔杖，深紫星点袍，脚边一弯小新月，重墨卡通描边
images.descEn: Fairy kid: a child with a star crown and feather wings holding a star-tipped wand, purple star-speckled robe, tiny crescent moon, heavy ink cartoon outline

images.name: 泡星光罐 · 奇食瓶罐
images.desc: 奇食瓶罐：玻璃泡星光罐，圆木塞，清液里悬浮几颗发光小星，颈系素牌画小星，侧视全身，重墨描边
images.descEn: Odd food jar: a glass jar with a cork lid, clear liquid holding glowing stars, a plain tag with a drawn star, side profile, heavy ink outline

images.name: 长芽泡菜坛 · 奇食瓶罐
images.desc: 奇食瓶罐：圆陶发酵坛带拱盖与小流口，坛口钻出卷曲绿芽，中段素色带，侧视全身，重墨描边
images.descEn: Odd food jar: a round ceramic crock with a domed lid and spout, curly sprouts poking out, plain band, side profile, heavy ink outline

images.name: 冒泡果酱瓶 · 奇食瓶罐
images.nameEn: Bubbling Jam Bottle · Odd Food Jar
images.desc: 奇食瓶罐：矮玻璃果酱瓶，格纹布盖系绳，瓶内红果酱冒泡上升，素牌画简单果形，侧视全身，重墨描边
images.descEn: Odd food jar: a short jam bottle with a checkered cloth cap, bubbling red jam, plain fruit label, side profile, heavy ink outline

images.name: 煮小云朵锅 · 奇食瓶罐
images.desc: 奇食瓶罐：圆肚铸铁小锅带两只短足与弯柄，锅内煮得小白云翻涌，一缕蒸汽，侧视全身，重墨描边
images.descEn: Odd food jar: a round cast-iron pot with stubby legs and a handle, tiny clouds boiling inside, wisp of steam, side profile, heavy ink outline

images.name: 装彩虹窄口瓶 · 奇食瓶罐
images.desc: 奇食瓶罐：高瘦窄口玻璃瓶，木塞，瓶内自底向上分层彩虹液，素空白牌，侧视全身，重墨描边
images.descEn: Odd food jar: a tall narrow bottle with a cork, layered rainbow liquid from bottom to top, blank tag, side profile, heavy ink outline

images.name: 结霜蜜罐 · 奇食瓶罐
images.nameEn: Frosted Honey Pot · Odd Food Jar
images.desc: 奇食瓶罐：圆陶蜜罐，罐口搁小蜜梳，外壁结霜挂冰晶，蜜巢纹饰带，侧视全身，重墨描边
images.descEn: Odd food jar: a rounded ceramic honey pot with a dipper on top, frost and ice crystals outside, honeycomb band, side profile, heavy ink outline

images.name: 卷毛短靴 · 长毛皮鞋
images.desc: 长毛皮鞋：牛皮短靴，靴口一圈卷曲羊毛，厚实鞋底，侧视全身，重墨描边
images.descEn: Furry boot: a leather ankle boot with a curly wool cuff and a sturdy sole, side profile, heavy ink outline

images.name: 长毛高筒靴 · 长毛皮鞋
images.desc: 长毛皮鞋：高及膝的长筒皮靴通体裹蓬松长毛，一道简系带，侧视全身，重墨描边
images.descEn: Furry boot: a knee-high leather boot wrapped in shaggy long fur with a simple lace, side profile, heavy ink outline

images.name: 兔毛小鞋 · 长毛皮鞋
images.desc: 长毛皮鞋：软皮小拖鞋通体覆长绒兔毛，顶上一颗圆绒球，侧视全身，重墨描边
images.descEn: Furry boot: a soft leather slipper covered in long bunny fur with a pom-pom, side profile, heavy ink outline

images.name: 熊爪毛靴 · 长毛皮鞋
images.desc: 长毛皮鞋：靴形如熊掌，踝与趾覆厚毛，露出小爪尖，侧视全身，重墨描边
images.descEn: Furry boot: a boot shaped like a bear paw with thick fur on ankle and toes, little claw tips, side profile, heavy ink outline

images.name: 流苏毛靴 · 长毛皮鞋
images.desc: 长毛皮鞋：皮靴侧垂流苏毛须，毛绒领口，一枚小扣带，侧视全身，重墨描边
images.descEn: Furry boot: a leather boot with hanging fur fringes and a furry collar, small buckle, side profile, heavy ink outline

images.name: 雪地毛靴 · 长毛皮鞋
images.desc: 长毛皮鞋：厚重雪地靴，靴口厚白毛边，齿纹厚底，侧视全身，重墨描边
images.descEn: Furry boot: a chunky winter boot with thick white fur trim and a ridged sole, side profile, heavy ink outline

images.name: 多眼毛虫 · 古怪虫豸
images.desc: 古怪虫豸：胖乎乎绒毛毛虫，身侧排六只咕噜眼，短足，重墨卡通描边
images.descEn: Weird bug: a plump fuzzy caterpillar with six googly eyes and tiny legs, heavy ink cartoon outline

images.desc: 奇门兵器：一根粗短黄铜炮管箍着铆钉铁环，侧面焊着圆压力表（表盘光溜溜什么刻度都没有），尾部铜锅炉阀门嘶嘶漏着一缕蒸汽，黑木托裂了缝，炮口熏黑还瘪了一块，无厘头童话风描边
images.descEn: Odd weapon: a stubby brass handgonne with riveted iron bands around the barrel, a small round pressure dial on the side with a plain needle and no markings at all, a rounded copper boiler at the rear leaking a wisp of steam from its valve, a cracked dark wooden stock, soot smudges and a dented muzzle, whimsical storybook outline

images.name: 双头磨盘锤 · 奇门兵器
images.desc: 奇门兵器：短粗橡木柄两头各嵌一只灰白石磨盘，盘沿钉满钝铁齿，一盘崩了三颗齿、另一盘缺了一颗，石头裂纹里卡着深色石粉，柄中一根锈螺栓穿过，缠着磨旧的布握把，无厘头童话风描边
images.descEn: Odd weapon: an absurd double-headed maul with a short thick oak handle fitted at both ends into heavy grey millstone discs ringed with blunt iron teeth, three teeth broken off one wheel and one missing from the other, dark stone dust in the cracks, a single rusty bolt pinning the middle of the handle with a worn cloth grip wrap, whimsical storybook outline

images.name: 锯齿飞轮 · 奇门兵器
images.desc: 奇门兵器：一面钢蓝色巨型环刃飞轮立在地上，外圈锯齿在一弧上崩掉了三颗露出光滑缺口，轮面划痕累累锈迹斑斑还有一小块卷了边，中心毂孔穿着一根帆布缠柄的短木棍，无厘头童话风描边
images.descEn: Odd weapon: an oversized steel-blue circular saw disc standing upright, jagged teeth around the rim with three broken off in one smooth arc, scratched rusty surface with a bent section of the rim, a central hub hole threaded with a short wooden handle wrapped in off-white canvas cloth, whimsical storybook outline

images.name: 独眼弹力球 · 怪兽玩具
images.desc: 怪兽玩具：一颗圆滚滚的蓝绿色橡胶弹力球，正中一只巨大的独眼带着卷卷的瞳孔，两侧长出两只小短手，咧嘴笑露出一颗蠢萌的门牙，头顶竖着一根呆毛，脸颊一道裂纹用干掉的橙色胶水胡乱补过，还带着几处磨痕，无厘头童话风描边
images.descEn: Monster toy: a round glossy teal rubber squish ball with one huge central eye and a tiny curled pupil, two stubby little arms poking out of the sides, a silly grin with one sticking-out tooth, a cowlick of hair on top, a hairline crack across one cheek sloppily patched with dried orange glue, tiny scuff marks, whimsical storybook outline

images.name: 啃咬骨胶 · 怪兽玩具
images.desc: 怪兽玩具：一根粗壮的米白色大骨头咬胶，一端长出一张小巧的怪兽牙床，两排钝牙齿僵在咬到一半的姿势，骨杆上满是深深的齿痕和啃咬沟，口水淌干成浅色渍，骨节磕掉一块，边缘磨得脏兮兮，无厘头童话风描边
images.descEn: Monster toy: a thick off-white chew bone with rounded knobbly ends, one end sprouting a tiny pair of toothy monster jaws frozen mid-chomp, deep tooth marks and gnaw grooves all along the shaft, dried slobber streaks, one knob chipped, scuffed dirty edges, whimsical storybook outline

images.name: 毛线球怪兽 · 怪兽玩具
images.desc: 怪兽玩具：一个缠得乱糟糟的粗毛线球，芥末黄、珊瑚红和蓝绿色条纹混在一起，线头炸得到处都是，毛线堆顶探出个小怪兽圆脑袋，两只小角和一只忧心忡忡的大眼，底部伸出一只毛茸茸的三趾脚，侧面还挂着抽丝的破口，无厘头童话风描边
images.descEn: Monster toy: a chunky tangled ball of knitted yarn in mustard, coral and teal stripes with loose threads sticking out everywhere, a small round monster head with two tiny horns and one big worried eye poking out of the top, one furry three-toed foot sticking out of the bottom, a snag with a dangling pulled thread, whimsical storybook outline

images.name: 发条铁皮怪 · 怪兽玩具
images.desc: 怪兽玩具：一尊褪色红配奶白的铁皮发条小怪兽，背上插着发条钥匙，耳朵缺口露出铆钉铁皮缝，三条小短腿踩着轮子，手肘膝盖掉漆露出灰铁，接缝处满是锈斑，一只玻璃眼珠直勾勾发愣，笑得歪歪斜斜，无厘头童话风描边
images.descEn: Monster toy: a chunky painted tin wind-up monster in faded red and cream with a wind-up key sticking out of its back, a riveted tin seam where an ear is missing, three stubby legs on little wheels, paint chipped off the elbows and knees exposing dull grey metal, rust spots along the seams, one glassy staring eye and a lopsided grin, whimsical storybook outline

images.name: 气球怪兽 · 怪兽玩具
images.desc: 怪兽玩具：一只紫绿长条气球拧成的瘦长怪兽，长脖子短四肢，卷尾巴，头顶的结拧成一只小巧的鼻子，两只画上去的卡通大眼，肚皮上贴一条银色胶带补着慢撒气，局部瘪了起皱还按了个指纹，无厘头童话风描边
images.descEn: Monster toy: a glossy violet and green balloon-animal monster with a long neck, stubby limbs and a curled tail, the knot tied at the top of its head like a little nose, two painted cartoon eyes, a silver duct tape strip patching a slow leak on its belly, deflated wrinkles and a smudged fingerprint, whimsical storybook outline

images.name: 拼布毛绒怪 · 怪兽玩具
images.desc: 怪兽玩具：一只拼布缝出来的毛绒小怪兽，灰粉、芥末和灰格纹布拼了一身，两颗大黑纽扣眼一颗松了垂着线头，背上一根黄铜拉链半开着冒出棉花，缝线粗大醒目，吐着布舌头，边缘磨得发白还有一块漂白渍，无厘头童话风描边
images.descEn: Monster toy: a soft stitched plush monster sewn from mismatched fabric patches in dusty pink, mustard and grey plaid, two big black button eyes with one loose and dangling threads, a brass zipper running down its back half-open with stuffing poking out, coarse visible stitching, a cloth tongue sticking out, worn fuzzy edges and a bleach stain, whimsical storybook outline

images.name: 长颈抖环兽 · 古怪走兽
images.desc: 古怪走兽：一头瘦骨嶙峋的长颈怪，脖子长得没道理还套了几十个锈铁环，一走就哗啦乱响，呆滞长脸半睁着眼，头顶一根歪独角，毛皮斑秃处缝着布补丁，四根牙签细腿膝盖外翻，细尾巴上拴个瘪铁罐，无厘头童话风描边
images.descEn: Odd beast: a scrawny mangy giraffe-like creature with an absurdly long wobbly neck stacked with dozens of rusty iron rings that rattle as it walks, a dopey long face with half-closed eyes, one crooked horn, patchy fur with bald spots and sewn cloth patches, four spindly toothpick legs with knobby knees, a thin tail with a bent tin can tied to the end, whimsical storybook outline

images.name: 伞骨蜗牛 · 古怪走兽
images.desc: 古怪走兽：一只胖大的灰褐蜗牛，壳是一把收拢的破雨伞铁骨架，伞骨放射如轮辐，一根弯了两根断，布面早就没了，两根眼柄顶端各挂一只瘪铃铛，宽肉蹼拖出黏涎痕，斜着眼一脸怯生生的样，无厘头童话风描边
images.descEn: Odd beast: a fat glossy grey-brown garden snail whose shell is the broken metal skeleton of a closed umbrella with ribs radiating like spokes, one bent rib and two snapped spokes, two wobbly eyestalks each tipped with a tiny dented bell, a wide slimy foot with wavy ripples, a shy side-eye glance and a slime trail, whimsical storybook outline

images.name: 缝嘴走犬 · 古怪走兽
images.desc: 古怪走兽：一只愁眉苦脸的小杂犬，全身像布偶一样用粗大十字针脚缝成，赭、锈红与灰的拼布布片东一块西一块，嘴被一根小黄铜拉链缝死，拉环垂在鼻子旁，耳朵一竖一耷，尾巴是个松散毛线球拖着线，四爪缝合处还蹦出几根线头，无厘头童话风描边
images.descEn: Odd beast: a small sad-eyed mutt whose whole body is sewn together with big crude cross-stitches like a patchwork of mismatched fabric panels in ochre, rust and grey, its muzzle zipped shut with a tiny brass zipper pull dangling at the nose, mismatched ears with one flopping, a tail that is a loose ball of yarn with a trailing thread, popped threads at the paw seams, whimsical storybook outline

images.name: 三头叠叠犬 · 古怪走兽
images.desc: 古怪走兽：一只灰粉色毛乱蓬蓬的三头猎犬垒成三层，上头叼住下头的尾巴，整摞狗咬着自己的尾巴成一个循环，六条瘦腿分两排，三张脸各摆各的呆相，耳朵耷向不同角度，中层的脖子挂只生满跳蚤的项圈，毛里缠着树枝，无厘头童话风描边
images.descEn: Odd beast: a shaggy dusty-pink three-headed hound stacked in three layers, the top head holding the bottom head's tail in its mouth so the whole stack bites itself in a loop, six scrawny legs in two rows, each head with a different dopey expression and floppy ears at different angles, matted fur with twigs and a flea collar on the middle neck, whimsical storybook outline

images.name: 风箱鼓气蜥 · 古怪走兽
images.desc: 古怪走兽：一只苔绿色胖蜥蜴，皮褶深得像把手风琴，腰侧绑着一只裂皮风箱囊，铜嘴里噗噗吐着小云团，四只脚是矮吸盘，眼珠子懒洋洋地斜瞟，颈鳍断了一根刺，身上干皮鳞片，尾巴尖磨秃了，无厘头童话风描边
images.descEn: Odd beast: a plump moss-green lizard with deep folded wrinkled skin like an old accordion, a cracked leather bellows pouch strapped to its flank with a brass nozzle puffing tiny clouds, four squat suction-cup feet, a lazy side-glancing eye, a frilled neck ruff with one torn spike, dry scaly patches and a scuffed tail tip, whimsical storybook outline

images.name: 糖杖驯鹿 · 古怪走兽
images.desc: 古怪走兽：一只粉玫瑰色胖驯鹿，四条腿是红白拐杖糖条纹，疙瘩鹿角上挂着用绳吊着的各色包装糖果，一身浅斑，鼻子沾着糖霜还被舔过一口，一根鹿角尖断了，脖铃裂了缝，糖纸角磕掉了几块，无厘头童话风描边
images.descEn: Odd beast: a plump dusty-rose deer with four legs striped red and white like candy canes, knobbly antlers hung with dangling wrapped candies on bits of string, pale spots on its coat, a frosted sugar-dusted nose with a lick mark, one antler tip snapped off, a bell collar with a cracked bell and chipped candy shells, whimsical storybook outline

images.name: 鮟鱇灯笼鱼 · 深海怪鱼
images.desc: 深海怪鱼：一条深青色胖鮟鱇，一嘴长短不齐的龅牙，额头钓竿挑着一盏暖黄灯笼，灯罩玻璃里还模模糊糊有个小怪兽剪影，肚皮缀着几粒青光小灯，鳞片磨花，鳍撕了个口子，一脸对眼的傻气，无厘头童话风描边
images.descEn: Odd fish: a plump dark indigo anglerfish with mismatched overbite fangs, a fishing-rod spine on its forehead tipped with a glowing warm-yellow lantern hiding a tiny monster silhouette inside the glass, small glowing cyan light dots along its belly, scuffed scales and a torn frayed fin, a dopey cross-eyed look, whimsical storybook outline

images.name: 管眼泡泡鱼 · 深海怪鱼
images.desc: 深海怪鱼：一条果冻粉的小鱼半透明身子，能看清里面几根小骨头和一颗吞下去的弹珠，双眼长在两根伸出老远的玻璃管顶端，各顶着一颗浑圆的大气泡眼球，管身泛着淡淡青光，鳍薄如纱，一脸愁容，无厘头童话风描边
images.descEn: Odd fish: a translucent jelly-pink fish showing tiny bones and one swallowed marble inside its semi-transparent body, its two eyes sitting at the ends of two long clear glassy tubes tipped with big round bubble eyeballs, a faint glowing cyan glow inside the tubes, wispy frayed fins, a worried expression, whimsical storybook outline

images.name: 獠牙蝰鱼 · 深海怪鱼
images.desc: 深海怪鱼：一条银蓝细长蝰鱼，咧嘴笑着一圈巨獠牙根本合不拢，一根特长一根磕了口，下巴吊着一根细须缀着紫光饵球，虹彩鳞片斑驳，圆眼里写满惊慌，尾鳍弯了鳃鳍撕了，额头还多长了一只小眼，无厘头童话风描边
images.descEn: Odd fish: a slender silver-blue viperfish with a huge grin of enormous curved fangs its mouth cannot close over, one fang longer than the other and a chipped tooth, a glowing violet lure dangling from its chin on a thin whisker, iridescent scale patches, big panicked eyes, a bent tail fin, a torn gill fin and a bonus small third eye on its forehead, whimsical storybook outline

images.name: 缎带皇带鱼 · 深海怪鱼
images.desc: 深海怪鱼：一条银白细长皇带鱼，身子拉成一条飘带的长度弯出几个舒缓的 S 弯，鲜红背鳍如一把破梳子从头梳到尾，一张小脸圆眼撇嘴委屈巴巴，带鳍拖在身后破破烂烂，背鳍缺了几根刺，鳞片磨花，无厘头童话风描边
images.descEn: Odd fish: an enormous ribbon-like silver oarfish with an absurdly elongated body undulating in gentle S-curves, a bright red frilly dorsal crest running along its back like a ragged comb, a small sad face with round eyes and a tiny pout, frayed tattered ribbon fins trailing behind, a few missing crest spikes and silver scale scuffs, whimsical storybook outline

images.name: 水滴鱼 · 深海怪鱼
images.desc: 深海怪鱼：一团软趴趴的淡粉水滴鱼，身子像化开似的往下瘫，一张听天由命的苦脸，眼角嘴角一齐往下掉，两个贴歪了的玻璃眼珠，皮肉松垮全是褶，几缕小愁斑，小鳍扑腾，无厘头童话风描边
images.descEn: Odd fish: a limp melting-looking pale pink blobfish with a saggy body pooling slightly at the bottom, a woeful resigned face with downturned eyes and a permanent worried frown, a couple of stuck-on googly eyes one slightly crooked, loose gelatinous skin folds and wrinkles, faint sad freckles and tiny flippers, whimsical storybook outline

images.name: 寄居怪蟹 · 深海怪鱼
images.desc: 深海怪鱼：一只铁锈色花寄居蟹，背的螺壳其实是个咧嘴笑的怪兽骷髅头，黑洞眼窝一排牙，一只钳子巨无霸一只小不点，细毛腿末端带着吸盘，壳上结满藤壶，壳沿磕掉一块，斜着一只小眼偷瞄，无厘头童话风描边
images.descEn: Odd fish: a mottled rust-brown hermit crab wearing a spiral shell that is actually a grinning monster skull with hollow eye sockets and a toothy jaw, one oversized claw and one tiny claw, thin hairy legs with tiny suction tips, barnacle patches crusted on the shell, a cracked shell rim with a chunk missing, one beady side-eye peeking out, whimsical storybook outline

images.name: 萨克斯秃鹫 · 怪鸟
images.desc: 怪鸟：一只灰褐色邋遢秃鹫，粉秃脑袋上挂着串晃晃悠悠的愁珠，长脖子整个换成一支弯弯曲曲的旧铜萨克斯，管身一排贝壳按键，该长尾羽的地方是一支瘪了口的萨克斯喇叭口，身侧支棱着几根乱翅羽，铜管磕得全是坑还泛着铜绿，无厘头童话风描边
images.descEn: Odd bird: a scruffy grey-brown vulture with a bald pink head wearing a dangling worry-bead necklace, its long neck replaced by a curved tarnished brass saxophone with pearl key buttons along its length, a bent saxophone bell flaring where its tail feathers should be, ragged wing feathers at the sides, scuffed and dented brass with greenish patina, whimsical storybook outline

images.name: 汤勺苍鹭 · 怪鸟
images.desc: 怪鸟：一只青灰色高脚苍鹭，两条筷子细腿拧着古怪的弯，嘴是一把特大号椭圆汤勺，勺底冲了三个漏孔，头顶一根呆毛直挺挺竖着，眼皮耷拉一脸没睡醒，翅羽乱糟糟，勺面磕了个坑还生了斑点锈，无厘头童话风描边
images.descEn: Odd bird: a pale blue-grey heron with two chopstick-thin legs bent at odd angles, an oversized oval soup spoon for a beak with three drain holes punched in it, one silly cowlick feather sticking straight up from its head, half-closed sleepy eyes, ragged wing feathers, a dent on the spoon bowl and a speckled patina, whimsical storybook outline

images.name: 喇叭鹦鹉 · 怪鸟
images.desc: 怪鸟：一只壮实的珊瑚红配蓝绿鹦鹉，头顶羽冠拧成一对羊角卷，尾巴是一支磕瘪了的黄铜小号，喇叭口朝后张着，管上三个活塞，一只翅膀振在半空，圆眼睛亢奋得溜圆，喙磕掉一块，铜管满是凹坑和一处铜绿，脚上还系个小铃铛，无厘头童话风描边
images.descEn: Odd bird: a chunky coral-red and teal parrot with a curled ram-horn crest of feathers on its head, its tail replaced by a dented brass trumpet with a flaring bell and three valve pistons, one wing raised mid-flap, round excited eyes, a scuffed beak with a chip, tarnished trumpet with dents and a green patina spot, a tiny bell tied to one leg, whimsical storybook outline

images.name: 邮差鸵鸟 · 怪鸟
images.desc: 怪鸟：一只圆滚滚的炭灰色鸵鸟邮差，背上帆布邮包撑得爆满，信函小包裹从包口溢出来，嘴里叼着一封信、头顶还稳稳顶着一封，细腿上掉了一只鞋，包带磨旧皮扣裂了缝，羽毛从包口破洞里支棱出来，一脸期盼的急切表情，无厘头童话风描边
images.descEn: Odd bird: a plump fluffy charcoal-grey ostrich with a bulging canvas mail satchel strapped to its back, stuffed so full that letters and small parcels spill out the top, a single envelope clutched in its beak and another balanced on its head, scrawny legs with one shoe missing, feather fluff poking out of a tear in the satchel, a worn leather strap with a cracked buckle, a hopeful eager expression, whimsical storybook outline

images.name: 茶壶企鹅 · 怪鸟
images.desc: 怪鸟：一只圆滚滚的黑白企鹅，头顶戳着一根茶壶嘴正噗噗冒着一缕蒸汽，弯弯的壶把手架在背上，白肚皮上画着一只大茶杯图案，鳍上掉了一块瓷漆还缠了圈创可贴，壶嘴根儿蹭着一小片煤灰，一脸心满意足的困意，无厘头童话风描边
images.descEn: Odd bird: a plump black-and-white penguin with a teapot spout sticking out of the top of its head puffing a tiny wisp of steam, a curved teapot handle arching over its back, a round white belly patch with a big painted-on tea-cup motif, chipped enamel paint on the flippers, one flipper wrapped with a bandage, a small soot smudge near the spout, a content sleepy face, whimsical storybook outline

images.name: 座钟布谷鸟 · 怪鸟
images.desc: 怪鸟：一只胖嘟嘟的木雕布谷鸟，松木身子雕成山间小屋样式，头顶铺着翘起的木瓦屋顶还缺了一片，肚皮上一扇小门敞着，尾巴是垂摆的铜摆锤，两只圆钟眼只有两根光杆指针，方嘴僵硬地半张着，棕漆掉色清漆泛黄，尾上挂着细细的黄铜链，无厘头童话风描边
